source_policy: Issuer/investor/regulatory/original journalism and publicly accessible professional funding records. Credible ballpark variations are retained without false precision; unavailable sources and unresolved private-close dates remain identified.
financial_limits: Source-supported disclosures include investment participation and offerings; they are not all distinct priced rounds or confirmed newly received cash.
Three added records are cumulative, year-only or cross-period context and are excluded from comparable period financing views.
Current product evidence does not independently certify a historical pivot date.
Professional financing records keep source/date-proxy labels; primary-source confirmation is not imputed.
Unknown amounts and valuations remain unknown. Public market recall is unmeasured; no comprehensive independent commercial export was available.
